CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetBaseTagData

Used inside a custom tag to reach the tag that encloses it. Returns a structure holding the ancestor's Attributes and ThisTag scopes, so a child tag can read its parent's settings and leave results for it.

Category

System functions

Syntax

GetBaseTagData(tagname [, instancenumber ])

Parameters

tagname
Name of the ancestor tag, for example "CF_SHOPPINGCART" (the CF_ prefix is part of the name).
instancenumber
Which matching ancestor to return when the same tag is nested several times. 1 (the default) is the nearest one.

Returns

The ancestor tag's local Variables scope, which also contains its Attributes and ThisTag structures. It is shared, not copied: changes you make are seen by the ancestor.

Usage

If no ancestor with that name is active, an Expression exception "Cannot find base tag" is thrown; check with GetBaseTagList first if the tag may be used on its own.

CFASSOCIATE is the other way for child tags to talk to their parent: it appends the child's attributes to an array in the parent's ThisTag scope.

Note  Keeping shared data in ThisTag, as the example does, makes the intent obvious to the next developer.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- sn_sysorder.cfm sets ThisTag.ItemCount = 0 in its start mode.
      Each sn_sysitem.cfm does:
        <CFSET Order = GetBaseTagData("CF_SN_SYSORDER")>
        <CFSET Order.ThisTag.ItemCount = Order.ThisTag.ItemCount + Attributes.Qty>
      and shows Order.Attributes.Customer in its row. --->
<CF_SN_SYSORDER CUSTOMER="Ada Lovelace">
  <CF_SN_SYSITEM PRODUCT="56K modem" QTY="1">
  <CF_SN_SYSITEM PRODUCT="Netscape 4.7 CD" QTY="2">
  <CF_SN_SYSITEM PRODUCT="Y2K compliance sticker" QTY="5">
</CF_SN_SYSORDER>

See also
